content.title: Introducing the Acquisition Knowledge Matrix
content.text: Introducing the Acquisition Knowledge Matrix As the sun sets on the Communities of Practice on September 30, DAU is excited to launch the new Acquisition Knowledge Matrix —a modern, structured content hub designed to enhance usability, discoverability, and access for the entire Acquisition Workforce. This transition marks a significant milestone in DAU’s digital transformation strategy, aligning content delivery with evolving user needs and technological capabilities. The acquisition knowledge matrix is taxonomy-driven system that organizes acquisition-related resources by functional areas and specific terms. The terms are derived directly from the content in the communities of practice, making discovery intuitive and topic-driven while encouraging exploration of related subjects. The acquisition knowledge matrix introduces two key dimensions: Category terms on the left-hand side Related content on the right-hand side Using the matrix is simple. Select the acquisition term of interest on the left-hand side. If there are terms with subtopics, you will see an arrow that you can click to expand. Once selected, all the content on the site tagged with that term will appear on the right-hand side. If you select a term that has subtopics underneath it, all content from all subtopics will appear. If the term you select has a page associated with it on the website, the option to go to that page will appear above the search results. Additionally, you can refine your results by typing specific search terms into the search bar above the results. The Communities of Practice over time collected a vast wealth of content from external agencies. This content is now available to any DAU.edu visitor. These items, referred to as artifacts, are either links to valuable resources from other government agencies or content that has been entrusted to DAU to maintain and share. DAU will continue to add new types of content to the acquisition knowledge matrix and we will update this space with information on the new features. If you are having any issues finding your content or require assistance, click on Submit a Ticket with your issue or explore our FAQs to answer your questions.
